description: Wave 3 — August 2026 research scope manifest. 30 entries: ROSE (10), SKYE (10), ELITE (10). External research conducted in EP-CAT-P10D (2026-08-22). All 30 entries researched. 29 entries READY; 1 entry FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED (UNISEX-49, Xerjoff withholds notes).

governance.researchedBy: Claude Code — EP-CAT-P10D Wave 3 Research Campaign

sourcePolicyTiers.tier2: Fragrantica.com, Basenotes.net, major authorised retailers (Amazon, Sephora, Kohl's, Nordstrom, authorized boutiques)

governance.admissibilityNote: LLM general knowledge is NOT admissible as a governed source. All claims must be traceable to a named external source. Fragrantica returns 403 on direct WebFetch; Fragrantica evidence comes from WebSearch snippets — classified HIGH rather than AUTHORITATIVE. Official brand pages accessed via WebFetch or WebSearch snippet are classified AUTHORITATIVE.
governance.schemaNote: This file follows the ResearchSourceEntry schema with Wave 3 extensions: evidenceStatus, researchRequired, researchNotes, proposedSlug, concentration. The ingestion script ignores unrecognised fields. entries.researchNotes: Canonical name confirmed: Queen of Silk EDP by Creed (2024). Notes sourced from Creed official site (T1 AUTHORITATIVE).

entries.researchNotes: Concentration resolved: EDP (1986 Jacques Polge reinterpretation). Original Parfum dates to 1921 (Ernest Beaux). EDP is the most widely retailed concentration and canonical supplier reference.
entries.sourceNotes: Concentration governance note: Supplier says 'Chanel No 5' without specifying concentration. EDP (1986, Jacques Polge) selected as canonical — most commonly retailed version. Original Parfum/Extrait is 1921 (Ernest Beaux). Chanel.com returned 403; notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) and Basenotes (corroborated). Distinct from all native Chanel records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Canonical name confirmed: Gabrielle Chanel EDP (2017, Olivier Polge). Notes researched EP-CAT-P10D.
entries.sourceNotes: Canonical name: 'Gabrielle Chanel' (official Chanel marketing name). Chanel.com product URL confirmed but returned 403; notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) and CaFleureBon review. Chanel marketing highlights four white flower heart notes (jasmine, ylang-ylang, orange blossom, tuberose) as the core composition. Distinct from all native Chanel records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Canonical name confirmed: Attrape-Rêves EDP by Louis Vuitton (2018, Jacques Cavallier Belletrud). Notes confirmed across three sources.

entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Bulgari'; canonical brand: 'Bvlgari'. Canonical product: Bvlgari Omnia Crystalline.

entries.researchNotes: Canonical name confirmed: Crazy in Love EDP by Montale (2021). Notes from Fragrantica (primary). Note source divergence documented in sourceNotes.
entries.sourceNotes: Two sources diverge significantly. Fragrantica (condensed primary): top Wild Rose/Violet Leaves, heart Saffron/Brown Sugar, base Amber/Vanilla Bean. Aedes.com (expanded): top Saffron/Rose/Cardamom/Lemon, heart Sandalwood/Bulgarian Rose/Violet Leaves, base Intense Amber/Vanilla/Brown Sugar/Amber Musk/White Musk/Oakmoss. Fragrantica used as primary (most widely cited fragrance database). Montaleparfums.com returned 404/403. Perfumer not disclosed in any source.
conflicts: Note pyramid diverges between Fragrantica (condensed) and Aedes.com (expanded). Fragrantica used as primary source.

entries.researchNotes: Identity verified via MIP-000006 (confidence 70, Awf 2026-08-08). Notes researched EP-CAT-P10D. Year confirmed: 2014. Perfumer: Francis Kurkdjian.
entries.sourceNotes: Canonical identity from MIP research (MIP-000006-ev-res): research confidence high. MIP source: Mid-Year 2026 Supplier List (mid-year-2026::mfk a la rose). Supplier abbreviation 'MFK' resolved to 'Maison Francis Kurkdjian'. Notes research (EP-CAT-P10D): Luckyscent presents notes as unordered bouquet; Fragrantica provides tiered structure — Fragrantica used as canonical for note pyramid. MFK official site unreachable. Some sources add Litchi/Pear (top) or Sweet Pea (heart) — not corroborated across primary sources, excluded per evidence governance.

Lapsang Souchong (smoky black tea) is the widely cited signature top note — used over 'Green Tea' variant in some older listings. Oakmoss placement in heart per corroborated sources. Distinct from native bvlgari-aqua-inspired (AQVA Pour Homme, W1 SKYE) and omnia-green-jade-inspired (W1 ROSE) confirmed.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Bulgari'; canonical brand: 'Bvlgari'. Canonical product: 'Black' by Bvlgari.

Notes consistent across Fragrantica (HIGH), thescentbase.com, and Perfumania. Carolina Herrera official confirms EDP concentration. Distinct from native very-good-girl-inspired and very-good-girl-elixir-inspired confirmed.

Flanker governance: AQVA Amara (2014) is a distinct flanker from AQVA Pour Homme (2005, native bvlgari-aqua-inspired, W1 SKYE) — different accord profile (bitter citrus/aquatic vs classic aquatic). CONFIRMED_DISTINCT_FLANKER, Founder selection governs. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) corroborated by FragranceReview.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Bulgari Aqua Amara'; canonical brand: 'Bvlgari'; canonical product: 'AQVA Amara' (not 'Aqua Amara').

entries.sourceNotes: Name resolution: supplier 'Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal NEW' resolved to canonical 'Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum' (2022 EDP Intense). Distinct from original 'Scandal Pour Homme' (2017 EDT). Note pyramid is deliberately minimal — 3 notes only, consistent across Fragrantica, Basenotes, Parfumo, and JPG official. A secondary source adds Caramel/Clary Sage/Vetiver but these are not corroborated by primary sources. Distinct from native scandal-inspired (JPG Scandal women's, W2 ROSE) and le-male-inspired (W2 SKYE) confirmed.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal NEW'; canonical name: 'Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum' (2022). 'NEW' is an internal supplier convention, not part of the official product name.

entries.researchNotes: Canonical product resolved: Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc EDT (2011, Sonia Constant). Supplier 'Lacoste White' is common shorthand.

Multiple flankers exist (2014 Limited Edition, 2021 EDP Blanc, 2022 Eau Fraiche, 2023 Eau Intense) with different compositions. Canonical reference is the 2011 original EDT — the primary product in the L.12.12 Blanc line. EDP variant (2021) has different composition and is excluded. Distinct from native lacoste-noir-inspired (W2 SKYE) confirmed. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH).
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Lacoste White'; canonical product: 'Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc' (2011 EDT).

Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) corroborated by Montale official US store and Nordstrom listing. Distinct from native arabians-musk-inspired (W1 ELITE) and arabians-tonka-inspired (W1 ELITE) confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Notes researched EP-CAT-P10D. UNORDERED_GOVERNED_NOTES applied — Jo Malone presents as flat bouquet. Three notes: Fig Leaf, Lotus Flower, Vetiver.
entries.sourceNotes: UNORDERED_GOVERNED_NOTES: Jo Malone London presents notes as unordered bouquet (not top/heart/base pyramid) — per Wave 2 governance precedent and brand policy. Notes recorded in heartNotes[] only: Fig Leaf, Lotus Flower, Vetiver. Brand description via authorized retailers (Cos Bar, Nordstrom) confirms three-note flat list. Fragrantica's top/heart/base breakdown is community-sourced and NOT how Jo Malone presents the fragrance. Concentration: Cologne (Jo Malone standard across core line). Launch: 2020 (Lost in Wonder collection). Perfumer not disclosed. Distinct from all five native Jo Malone records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Research conducted. GOVERNANCE GAP: Xerjoff explicitly does NOT publish official notes for the 'Join the Club' collection. Notes listed below are community-sourced from Fragrantica — NOT confirmed by brand. Founder decision required: proceed with LOW-confidence community notes, or accept an evidence-only description without specific notes.
entries.sourceNotes: GOVERNANCE FLAG — FOUNDER DECISION REQUIRED: Xerjoff officially states notes for all 'Join the Club' collection fragrances are kept secret (confirmed on xerjoff.com product page). Notes in this record are crowd-sourced/community-inferred from Fragrantica and third-party sites — NOT confirmed by Xerjoff. Source confidence: LOW. Canonical name: 'TORINO24' (official Xerjoff spelling, no space; commonly written 'Torino 24' with space by third parties). Options: (A) Proceed with LOW-confidence community notes for product description — acceptable if brand secret is noted in copy; (B) Leave notes field empty and write fragrance description from brand narrative only. Perfumer not disclosed.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Official Xerjoff spelling is 'TORINO24' (no space). Third parties use 'Torino 24' (with space). Both forms circulate.
conflicts: Xerjoff does not publish official notes. Community-sourced notes are inferred, not brand-confirmed.
